item.stem:
The diagram shows Vihaan's algebra grid. One row has three identical blue squares with sum $24$. The next row has two identical red circles and one blue square with sum $22$. Each shape stands for one unknown value.

Which plan finds the values correctly?

options.A: Call each shape an unknown and stop, leaving the sums $24$ and $22$ unused.
options.B: Filling empty cells is what produces the row sums $24$ and $22$.
options.C: From three blue squares summing to $24$, one blue square is $8$. Then two red circles plus $8$ sum to $22$, so one red circle is $7$.
options.D: Factorise $24$ and $22$ into primes and treat those factors as the shape values.
